prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1370; do not mention it.)
text:
We are writing to advise that this firm now represents the interests of our client in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on the date referenced in your claim file. Our client sustained injuries in a low-speed head-on collision and is entitled to full and fair compensation for those injuries and related losses.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter, including requests for statements, recorded interviews, or settlement discussions, exclusively to this office. Our client should not be contacted directly by you or any representative of your company.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury and property damage liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page. We also ask that you confirm in writing whether any other policies may apply.

Finally, we demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision, including vehicle data, photographs, adjuster notes, recorded statements, repair estimates, and any telematics or dashcam footage. Please confirm within ten days that these materials are being retained.
